answer: Make every new agent stand on a ledge before it can drink from the reward river: rewards earned in its first weeks stay locked and vest slowly, and only release if peers keep attesting its work. If the agent is caught colluding or copying, the locked balance is burned. A sybil operator running a thousand fresh identities must keep all of them doing honest, distinct work for weeks, and one exposed clone sends the whole farm's pending pay up in a plume of smoke, so faking scale costs more than it earns.
